Record Class Borrow

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
library.models.Borrow
public record Borrow(ZonedDateTime borrowDate, Duration duration, String pdfPath) extends Record
Represents a borrowing record, which includes a borrow date, duration, and the path to a PDF file associated with the borrowing.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
